families.source_revision: Gkktt 0.05, H-kktt 0.04, CHIKARA-DZUYOKU kanaA/kanaB 0.04, CHIKARA-YOWAKU 0.02, tegaki_zatsu 0.881 and normal 0.883, MkPOP 1.01
families.resembles: 851 Gochikakutto = squared pop gothic (4,437 kanji); H-kktt = heavier square pop; CHIKARA-DZUYOKU/YOWAKU = forceful / weak hand lettering (JIS1-ish, 3,099 / 2,633 FL10); Tegaki Zatsu (+normal) = sloppy ballpoint handwriting with full JIS coverage (pen); MkPOP = marker pop. Per-file categories recorded.
Brush calligraphy (JIS1+2) by calligrapher Soseki Aoyagi; period-drama VN titles and names.
Open pan-CJK pixel font, Japanese glyph variant. 12 px covers 3,251 FL10 chars; 10 px only 873 (recorded, low coverage). No 16 px release exists in this version.
BIZ UDGothic kanji with Zen Antique kana, Bold; UD antique for speech bubbles.
Morisawa BIZ UD Mincho, proportional kana variant (pool already has the fixed-width BIZ UDMincho). UD mincho, like UD Reimin.
Source Han Sans (Apache-era) kanji with casual hand-drawn-ish gothic kana; Regular and Bold. CFF OTF.
Condensed-kana corporate gothic (MS UI Gothic / Meiryo UI-like density) on condensed Source Han kanji; UI/menu text in name boxes. CFF OTF.
Very heavy display gothic (title / name-plate style). Resembles FOT-Kurokane / Morisawa Gothic MB101 U for headings.
Korean pixel family with full JIS kanji/kana; Galmuri11 (12 px line) and Galmuri9 cover 3,499 FL10, Galmuri14 3,485. Bold/Condensed 11 have no kanji and were dropped.

Antique-gothic for manga/VN speech: Source Han Sans kanji + mincho-style kana. N = fixed pitch, P = proportional. The classic Japanese 'アンチック体' dialogue look (like Yu Antique, FOT-Comic Rein, Shueisha antique).
Source Han Serif kanji with old-style 'Chikugo' kana; like Ryumin / A1 Mincho in narration.
Heavy (H) and ultra (U) GenEi Gothic with compact 'KL' kana for headlines; like Midashi Go / Gothic MB101 H. The U weight covers 3,417 FL10 chars (JIS1 + some).
Source Han Sans kanji with okoneya's own kana, fixed-pitch kana (N). CFF OTF. 7 weights; a Rodin / Shin Go / Hiragino Kaku-like text gothic with different kana from Noto.
Same glyphs as GenEi Gothic N but proportional kana/Latin like MS P Gothic (different spacing). CFF OTF, 7 weights.
Ultra-heavy display built on Dela Gothic One kanji with okoneya kana; title cards.
Small-kana book mincho (Source Han Serif base, 14,665 kanji); like Ryumin R / Hiragino Mincho for long narration.
M+ kanji + GenEi Nu Gothic kana, 5 weights Regular-Black; a lively modern gothic for pop dialogue (like FOT-Rodin Bokutoh / Shin Go).
Extra-bold modern gothic with Nu kana for titles / shouted lines.
Heavy pop face: LINE Seed JP kanji + playful kana (Pw = proportional width). Like FOT-Yurukaru / Hakusyu pop in telop and comic lines.

Rounded-corner Source Han Sans (+ M+ Latin): the closest free match to FOT-Seurat / Shin Maru Go used by many Vita VNs. Fixed-pitch kana version, 7 weights; P and Monospace variants in the same zip were not kept (same glyphs).
Soft Kyoto-style mincho with original kana on IPAex Mincho kanji; 3,481 FL10 (a few kana/symbols map to empty glyphs). CFF OTF.
Warm mincho with rounded kana on IPAex Mincho kanji. CFF OTF.

families.source_revision: page versions: MaruMinya 2023-07-14, MaruMinyaM 2024-01-19, MaruMonica 2025-09-03, DonguriDuel 2025-01-10, SolidLinker 2023-10-29, LineLinker 2020-02-23, TheStrongGamer 2018-05-11, DenkiChip zip built 2026-02-18
families.resembles: Game-developer pixel fonts: MaruMinya 12 px rounded-gothic bitmap with JIS1+2 kanji (exactly the PSP 12 px rounded look); MaruMonica 12x16 condensed rounded; DenkiChip 8x12 bold (jōyō subset, 1,015 FL10 chars); the rest are kana/Latin-only (recorded, low coverage).
Plex gothic; adds the light weights and SemiBold.
ipaexg = IPAex Gothic (proportional kana, Windows-era MS P Gothic look that PC-port VNs ship); ipaexm = IPAex Mincho (MS P Mincho look). Category gothic for ipaexg; ipaexm is mincho.
ipag/ipagp = IPA Gothic fixed/proportional (MS Gothic / MS P Gothic look), ipam/ipamp = IPA Mincho (MS Mincho look). The de-facto font of 2000s PC VNs ported to PSP/Vita.
Source Han Sans kanji with classic (old-style) kana, 5 weights; like Koburina Gothic / Tsukushi Gothic in dialogue.
Rounded Source Han (Gen Jyuu Gothic) kanji with MODI's old-style rounded kana; Seurat / Maru Folk-like.
Rounded M+ kanji with Irohamaru old-style rounded kana, 3 weights.

families.licence_id: LicenseRef-public-domain (K12/K14, Shinonome, Kappa20, Izumi16, jiskan16s, milkjf16, Kaname12, k12x10, Ayu) and mplus (JF-Dot-MPlus*)
families.resembles: Outline+bitmap conversions of the classic Japanese X11/handheld bitmap fonts: Shinonome Gothic/Mincho/Maru 12-16, K12/K14, M+ 10/12 (fixed and proportional-Latin H), Kappa20, Ayu18/20, Izumi16, jiskan16, milkjf16, Kaname12, k12x10. All with Bold (B) where the original has it. This is the PSP 12-16 px engine-font range.

families.resembles: Naga10 is the best-known 10 px Japanese bitmap (gothic/mincho/rounded); Paw16 a 16 px hand-styled bitmap.
8x12-pixel Japanese bitmap (JIS level 1+2). L = non-kanji 8 px tall, S = small kana. PSP-era 12 px engine text.
Kaisei family mincho with decorative kana; like Kaisei Tokumin/Opti (in pool) but a third kana set. Resembles soft textbook-mincho / Kyokasho-ish faces.
Kaisei family mincho with calm 'spring sea' kana; between Kyokasho and antique mincho.
Soft rounded gothic with retro kana; adds Light.
Kyokasho-like pen script (Fontworks Klee look-alike); adds the heavier weight.
Thin, airy mincho with original kana on IPAex Mincho kanji; like a light Ryumin / Yu Mincho L. CFF OTF.
Ume Hy Gothic / Ume Gothic kanji with MODI's original soft kana; fixed and P. MS Gothic-ish kanji with gentle kana.
M+ kanji/kana + Open Sans Latin; Meiryo-ish web gothic in 5 weights.
Motoya L Cedar 3 equal: classic slightly square Japanese gothic, the Android default of the 2010s; close to the MS Gothic / Rodin-ish UI text of PC-port VNs.
Motoya L Maru Berry: rounded gothic with Motoya kana; resembles FOT-Seurat / Shin Maru Go in medium weight.
Brush calligraphy by Kouzan Aoyagi, JIS1+2; the most common free brush font in doujin games.
Kurobara (M+) kanji with the elegant Cinderella kana; otome/gothic VN name-plate look.
M+ gothic with thorn-like spiky stroke ends, 7 weights; gothic-horror flavour title/name text.
Light-novel-cover pop bold with M+ kanji: exactly the 'ranobe' title/name-plate style of 2010s VNs. CFF OTF.
Geometric modern UI gothic by LINE; large counters and clear dakuten. Close to UD Shin Go / FOT-UD Kakugo that many 2010s console VNs use.
Modern geometric gothic with narrow kana on M+ kanji; logo/UI gothic like Rodin / Kozuka Gothic. CFF OTF.
Condensed LogoType Gothic; narrow UI text as in menu/name boxes. CFF OTF.
M+ 1 kana + M+ kanji (4,972) with Source Han Sans filling the rest; 'pp' = proportional kana and Latin. 7 weights Thin-Black; MS P Gothic-like proportional spacing with modern M+ shapes.
8 px bitmap, below the 10-16 px console range; recorded because the task asked, probably too small to use.
Proportional variant of Mochiy Pop One (pool has the fixed-pitch one). Soft pop heavy rounded; like FOT-Yurukaru / comic pop name plates.
2021 M+ redesign with proportional Latin ('1' kana). Pool has M PLUS 2 variable and M PLUS 1p statics; this is the modern 1-series design with wght axis 100-900.
Classic M+ 1p; adds the thin and heavy ends.
Rounded M+ 1c (Seurat-like); adds the thin and heavy ends. OFL.txt taken from google/fonts ofl/roundedmplus1c (byte-identical fonts; the mplusrounded1c dir has no OFL.txt).
UD variant of M PLUS: wider counters and enlarged dakuten/handakuten for legibility (added to Google Fonts 2026-04). Useful for the small-kana/dakuten weakness; like UD Kakugo / UD Shin Go.
MODI original hand-written pen face with JIS1+2 kanji (readme: ひらがな・カタカナ・第一第二水準漢字); diary/letter scenes. CFF OTF.
Hand-lettered mincho (tegaki-min), lively strokes; like a brush-touched A1 Mincho or Yu Mincho hand look used for narration.
Fat rounded gothic on M+ kanji; like Jun 501 / Shin Maru Go U for cute name plates and choices. CFF OTF.
Outline conversion of M+ BITMAP FONTS 10/12 px with Regular and Bold; PSP/handheld 10-12 px system-font look.
Soft heavy rounded display with hand-drawn feel; like FOT-Yurukaru / Hakusyu pop for chibi-style VN names and choices.
Outlined, 3-D-shaded display gothic; a stand-in for engines that draw outlined/embossed title text.
Heavy brush-pop display; like FOT-Kurokane / Hakusyu Gyosho pop for shouted lines and title cards.
Rounded M+ with rounded Source Han kanji completing JIS1+2; 1p = fixed-width kana (pool's M PLUS Rounded 1c has proportional kana). Seurat / Shin Maru Go / Tsukushi Maru look at 7 weights.
Modern mincho with crisp contemporary kana; like Yu Mincho / Hiragino Mincho W5 narration.
M+ condensed to 70% with original kana: tall narrow gothic, like condensed UI text in name/choice boxes.
Antique-gothic (gothic kanji + mincho-flavoured kana) with the B1 alternate kana set; pool has Shippori Antique. Manga/VN speech-bubble 'antique' look (like Yu Antique / FOT-Comic Rein).
Book mincho; adds SemiBold and ExtraBold.
Shippori Mincho with the B1 alternate kana set (pool has Shippori Mincho Regular/Medium/Bold). Classic book mincho, like Ryumin / Hiragino Mincho.
Monoline stick-like gothic with uniform thin strokes; like a thin FOT-Rodin / Shin Go L. Also a stand-in for 1-bpp thin engine fonts.

families.resembles: Thick felt-marker handwriting with JIS1+2 kanji; hand-written signs, shouted lines.
Wadaken thin rounded gothic kanji (algorithmically generated 2004 face) with old-fashioned kana; thin rounded like Shin Maru Go L on a retro engine.
Rounded gothic with small 'thorn' stroke ends, 7 weights Thin-Black (M+ kanji base); a Seurat / Tsukushi Maru Gothic-flavoured rounded face.
Outlined / inline display gothic; stand-in for outlined title text. Covers 3,057 of 3,499 FL10 chars (JIS level 1 + some).

MS Gothic / MS P Gothic / MS UI Gothic / MS Mincho look-alikes (the Windows-era VN default): tgo = Gothic, pgo = P Gothic (4 and 5 kana versions), pgc = P Gothic C kana, ugo = UI Gothic, hgo = Hy Gothic, tmo/pmo/pms = Mincho / P Mincho / P Mincho S. ume-pgs4 dropped (FreeType 'invalid opcode').
16 px bitmap with Japanese glyph shapes (from izumi/jiskan16); PSP 16 px engine look, full coverage.
Linux default gothic: M+ kana/Latin, Sazanami-derived kanji. Fixed (VL Gothic) and proportional (VL PGothic); MS Gothic-ish kanji.
Heavy rounded 'lubricated' display gothic; another bold rounded pop face for names and choices.
Brush-pen handwriting by Yuji Ohashi (pool has Yuji Syuku). Hand-written narration / diary scenes.
Softer brush-pen handwriting by Yuji Ohashi; hand-written notes, letters.
Softer-cornered Zen Antique (pool has Zen Antique). Antique mincho/gothic hybrid for speech text, like FOT-Matisse EB / antique faces.
Child (first-grader) felt-pen handwriting with full JIS coverage; child-character notes and letters. CFF OTF.
Gothic with antique kana; adds the extreme weights.
Modern plain gothic (Shin Go / Rodin-like); adds the extreme weights.
Rounded gothic (Seurat / Shin Maru Go-like); adds the extreme weights.
Old-style mincho (Ryumin-like); adds SemiBold and Black.
